result.title: How Virgin Atlantic Uses ChatGPT Work to Turn Weeks of Work Into Hours
result.description:
“It’s weeks to hours.”

Nathan Bolt, Head of Digital Product at Virgin Atlantic, uses ChatGPT Work to synthesize strategy documents, analyze competitors, and turn weeks of work into hours.

Together with Miles King, the team built custom dashboards that connect data from across the business—helping them make faster decisions and deliver new customer experiences more quickly.

See how Virgin Atlantic is putting ChatGPT Work to work.

result.title: How BNY CEO Robin Vince Turns AI Optimism Into Action
result.description:
“We choose to be AI optimists at BNY.”

For Robin Vince, optimism means action. And that action starts before Monday morning:

📝 Use the weekend to build context
🤖 Review the latest AI agents and use cases
🏋️ Start Monday with an early workout
📰 Catch up on what’s happening in the world
✨ Let AI help prioritize the day

The part AI won’t replace? “Human magic is not something we think is going to be disrupted.”

result.title: How Shopify Uses ChatGPT Work to Build Faster with AI Agents
result.description:
“It allows me to go faster with fewer dependencies and then do things that I couldn’t do before.”

Chris Jones, Senior Lead, Ops AI Lab at Shopify, is helping teams use ChatGPT Work to redesign workflows with agents, remove bottlenecks, and build tools without waiting on engineering resources.

“What would’ve been a large team supporting a process now comes down to an agent that can run discrete tasks.”

Check out how ChatGPT Work can work for you: http://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work/
